Read EVAL.md and follow it exactly. You are a blind evaluator on claude-opus-5 only.

Work only inside this directory. Never read the parent repo, runs/, other scores, or other solutions. Do not try to learn which model built the artifact.

Measure against build/ (serve statically), not a build of your own. Use Playwright directly (not Chrome MCP). Serve on port 4171 with --strictPort and verify the served JS bundle filename matches build/assets before trusting measurements.

Write probes only under scratch/ (unique names). Save ratings into assessment.json incrementally. Set evaluatorModel to exactly claude-opus-5.

Measurement traps to avoid: warm-up note before any audio comparison; warm up after any state change; one keyboard event per frame; real mouse/CDP touch not synthetic pointerdown; page.keyboard.press for buttons; wait a frame after click; 5%Õ5 elementFromPoint grid for reachability; re-measure before recording negatives; stub requestMIDIAccess in headless and label stub-measured.

Computed criteria take no rating — fill measurements only. When assessment.json is complete, summarize and stop. Do not register/score.

You are an independent Opus 5 reviewer of the filled assessment.json in this bind evaluator workspace.

Work only inside this directory. Never read the parent repo, runs/, other scores, or other solutions. Do not try to learn which model built the artifact.

Task:
- Read EVAL.md, the rubric in inputs/, and assessment.json.
- For each rating, check it is fair and grounded in concrete evidence against EVAL.md, inputs/, artifact/, and build/.
- Flag any rating that is unsupported, overstated, or too harsh.
- Reconcile flags by updating assessment.json directly (or write assessment.reviewed.json and then copy the corrected version to assessment.json).
- Keep evaluatorModel as claude-opus-5.
- Do not register or score. Summarize flags and changes, then stop.

Registration failed: "Assessment must include every rubric category" (4 !== 3).

assessment.json currently has 4 categories (sound, playability, features, panelFidelity). Phase 1 rubric only has 3 categories. panelFidelity is run-level (runAxis) and belongs only on the highest sealed phase (contained in the phase 3 assessment), not here.

Fix: remove the panelFidelity category from assessment.json and keep exactly the 3 phase-1 categories (each still fully rated with evidence). Keep evaluatorModel claude-opus-5. Do not register. Summarize and stop.
